name: sidebar
useFor: Wrap the app in SidebarProvider; put Sidebar (SidebarHeader, SidebarContent with SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel and SidebarMenu rows, SidebarFooter, SidebarRail) beside SidebarInset holding the page and its SidebarTrigger. Mark the current row with isActive, give rows a tooltip for the icon rail (collapsible="icon"), and use SidebarMenuBadge for a count. Cmd or Ctrl and B toggles it.
constraints: A dark or white rail on the gray ground
source: The Hoplite website's blog post rail (.bp-rail, .bp-rail__label, .bp-rail__link), changelog rail (.cl-rail, .cl-rail__label) and nav items (.hn__top: graphite label turning ink on the hover wash)

title: Sidebar
description: The app's rail: 288px of the ground with a quiet rule on its inner edge, Kode Mono group labels, 36px rows of a 20px glyph and a 14px graphite label that take the hover wash and turn ink under the pointer or when current, Kode Mono counts, nested rows on a quiet rule, and a ruled foot. It narrows to its glyphs or slides away, and becomes a sheet on a phone. The body fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y), so no row is cut off under the header.
